title: Fix error message formatting bug - ~s placeholders not substituted
description:
Error messages display literal ~s and ~:s placeholders instead of actual values, making debugging difficult.

Examples:
- (string-ref "abc" 10) shows '~s is not a valid index for ~s' instead of actual values
- (car '()) shows '~s is not a pair' instead of the value
- (+ "5" 3) shows '~s is not a number' instead of '5'

Root cause: Error handler not properly passing values to format function, or condition objects not capturing values correctly.

Location: Error formatting in thimble/error-fmt.ss and core error handling

See docs/EXPLORATION-FINDINGS.md for full details.

Priority: P0 - Critical for developer experience

title: Remove third-party dependencies from thimble/mcp-server
description:
The mcp-server package currently depends on external npm packages:

Dependencies:
- @modelcontextprotocol/sdk (^1.0.4)

DevDependencies:
- @types/node (^22.0.0)
- typescript (^5.7.2)

This violates the project principle: 'No Third-Party Dependencies - Everything is built in-house. If we need a tool, we build it. Exceptions require approval from Andy.'

Required:
- Replace @modelcontextprotocol/sdk with in-house implementation
- Remove npm dependency chain
- Implement MCP protocol directly in Scheme/Fold

Priority: P2 - Consistency with project principles
